'''Bulwark''' was a [[Planet/Legends|planet]]<ref name="GG3" /> located in the [[Bulwark system/Legends|Bulwark system]] of [[Wild Space/Legends|Wild Space]].<ref name="Atlas" /> During the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], Bulwark served as a [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] [[Safe world/Legends|safe world]]<ref name="GG3" />&mdash;a designated planet where people connected with the Alliance could live free of [[New Order/Legends|oppression]] from the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]].<ref name="RAS">[[The Rebel Alliance Sourcebook (Second Edition)|''The Rebel Alliance Sourcebook'', Second Edition]]</ref> It was also among the few sites to which the Rebel Alliance allocated one of their [[V-150 Planet Defender/Legends|v-150 Planet Defender]] [[Ion cannon/Legends|ion cannons]].<ref name="GG3" />

==Behind the scenes==
Bulwark was mentioned in the [[1996]] second edition of [[Galaxy Guide 3: The Empire Strikes Back (Second Edition)|''Galaxy Guide 3: The Empire Strikes Back'']], a sourcebook for [[West End Games]]' ''[[Star Wars: The Roleplaying Game]]''. The second edition expanded on the sourcebook's [[Galaxy Guide 3: The Empire Strikes Back|original text]] with new and revised content by author [[Pablo Hidalgo]].<ref name="GG3" />

The [[StarWars.com]] [[Star Wars: The Essential Atlas Online Companion|Online Companion]] to the [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'' placed the Bulwark [[Star system/Legends|system]], and therefore the planet itself, in grid square U-7.<ref name="Atlas" />
